label: suspect

unstated.what: Malformed/invalid HTTP-date in If-Unmodified-Since or If-Range must be ignored (response 200) rather than raising or returning 412
unstated.quote: lastmod = 'not a valid HTTP-date' ... assert 200 == resp.status

unstated.what: Exact conditional response bodies/headers: 412 with no body, 206 with Content-Range/Content-Length, and full 200 file (Content-Length 13) when If-Range date is stale
unstated.quote: assert 412 == resp.status ... assert resp.headers['Content-Range'] == 'bytes 2-12/13' ... assert resp.headers['Content-Length'] == '11'

instruction_covers: Content-Range header on 206 responses with exact format 'bytes start-end/size'
honoring If-Unmodified-Since and If-Range for ranged and non-ranged requests
reason: Content-Range format, 416 behavior, and tail clamping are all stated in the issue. The only unstated requirements are the invalid-date fallback (treat unparseable dates as absent) and exact response sizes/headers, both standard RFC 7233/7232 behavior a careful implementer would produce.
